summary: Murlok +40 (03:00Z cut); Mythicstats 1078 matured, 38 rows; 240 tier letters re-parsed, 0 moves; Archon walled night 4 (403); 3 takes + 7 metaNotes from 5 transcripts.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 196-343 KB (r.jina.ai deliberately not tried - it is IP-403 on these hosts). <style> blocks stripped BEFORE parsing, because the page ships its whole tier-list CSS inline and an unstripped anchor matches stylesheet rules; the <table class="tier-list"> count was then asserted EXACTLY 1 per page. Letter read from each row's first <td>, spec from each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster. Counts reconciled to 27/7/6 per bracket = 80 rows BEFORE any merge: 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, every letter inside the registered 7-band icyveins scale. Upstream still publishes exactly TWO M+ DPS specs as TBD (Windwalker Monk, Frost Death Knight) and both stay explicit nulls. ALL 80 letters are byte-identical to stored, so nothing was merged and specs.json is untouched by this source; the page snapshots advanced to 2026-08-28 on tonight's fetch. Page self-dates re-read from JSON-LD dateModified and unchanged: raid DPS 2026-08-23, raid healer 2026-08-24, raid tank 2026-08-08, M+ DPS 2026-08-23, M+ healer 2026-08-23, M+ tank 2026-08-23 - identical to the stored published values AND to the pre-agent published-evidence artifact (attemptedAt 2026-08-28T21:14:48Z), so that cross-check has three agreeing witnesses. Era-verified s2 on all six from the BODY, not the title: the raid HEALER page still titles itself 'Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight' while its body counts Season 2 21 times against Season 1 six - body over title, the blue-tracker precedent. seasonVerified unchanged (s2 on all six), so freeze-season had nothing to consider.

Both pages fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200: /guides/tier-list/raiding 159 KB and /guides/tier-list/mythic-plus 166 KB. CSS stripped before parsing, letters read from each tier__tier block's tier__title, specs from each entry's img alt. Extra tierlists rejected by ROSTER MATCH, never by position: the M+ page's nine unmatched images are the eight dungeon-difficulty blocks (Altar of Fangs, Den of Nalorakk, King's Rest, Murder Row, Ruby Life Pools, Temple of Sethraliss, The Blinding Vale, Voidscar Arena) plus the Method logo, and the raid page's single unmatched image is the logo. 40 rows per bracket, 0 duplicates, letters confined to the registered 4-band method scale S|A|B|C. All 80 letters byte-identical to stored - nothing merged; snapshots advanced to 2026-08-28 on tonight's fetch. Page self-dates read from the body's 'Last Updated' line: raid 10th August 2026, M+ 13th August 2026 (the M+ list is bylined Tactyks), both unchanged. Era-verified s2 from the body: the raid page says 'the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss' and the M+ page 'dungeon difficulty in Midnight Season 2'; all 40 roster specs including Devourer matched on both. Method carries no published field in the registry, so these self-dates are recorded here rather than written into sources.json - adding a field is registry structure, not an agent-updatable value.

All 6 pages fetched with the full browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403), HTTP 200, 73-339 KB; r.jina.ai deliberately NOT tried first, it has been IP-403 on wowhead.com/guide/* since 2026-08-03. Parse: unescape backslash-slash across the WHOLE document FIRST, then locate [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] in the unescaped text - never anchored on WH.markup.printHtml(, the decoy that once returned 0 rows for the raid-healer page. Exactly ONE tier-list block found per page, asserted. Tier labels matched with tolerant whitespace and specs resolved from the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug, which sidesteps the two-word-class split. Counts reconciled before merging: 27/7/6 per bracket = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, 0 duplicates, letters inside the registered 7-band wowhead scale. ZERO letters moved. Page self-dates from dateModified are byte-identical to stored and to the pre-agent published-evidence artifact on all six: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 2026-08-18, raid tank 2026-08-14, M+ DPS 2026-08-18, M+ healer 2026-08-26, M+ tank 2026-08-18. The M+ healer page that rebuilt on 08-26 and carried the Holy Priest C->B move has neither re-dated nor moved again, which is the right shape for real upstream movement settling. Era-verified s2 on all six from body and title; Devourer present in both DPS pages. seasonVerified unchanged; snapshots advanced to 2026-08-28. Standing flag, unchanged and still an owner decision (flag, never retire): all four bylined Wowhead tier-list pages are written by registered creators (raid DPS + raid tank Dratnos, M+ DPS tettles, M+ healer AutomaticJak) - and see the creators row, where that firewall bit tonight.

Site-wide human-verification wall for a FOURTH consecutive night, and the shape has reverted to the 08-25/08-26 form: every one of the 12 registered pages returns HTTP 403, 5.7-6.0 KB, <title>Just a moment...</title>, with __NEXT_DATA__ count 0 - NOT the HTTP 200 'Human Verification / One Quick Check' interstitial the 08-27 nightly measured. Asserted on __NEXT_DATA__ presence rather than the status code, exactly as the contract row instructs, because tonight a status-only check would have called it a clean 403 while last night's would have recorded success on an empty page. Measured rather than inferred: the site ROOT https://www.archon.gg/wow returns the same 403 (it is not a tier list and has no reason to be gated on its own), and a second transport, r.jina.ai, now returns HTTP 200 with a 232-byte body whose entire content is the 'Human Verification / One Quick Check' page - the inverse of last night, where direct was 200 and the proxy 403. Two transports plus a root probe is what makes 'the site is walled' a measurement about upstream rather than a guess about our parse; the 08-27 residential-IP local run had already ruled out an IP-scoped explanation. Nothing merged, no snapshot bumped, stored letters byte-identical. Standing consequence: Archon is the only tier source still describing S1, so this wall is also holding off the one consensus recomposition the anomaly gate is waiting for, and consensusFor stays at Icy Veins + Method + Wowhead.

Not reachable - same site-wide human-verification wall as archon-tiers (HTTP 403 + Cloudflare challenge on every page including the site root, __NEXT_DATA__ absent; r.jina.ai reaches only the 'Human Verification' interstitial). The per-boss and per-dungeon pages were probed individually (nekzali, altar-of-fangs) and returned the identical 403. data/encounter-tiers.json untouched; its season stamp and all 619 tier rows are byte-identical, and the Fight selector stays season-gated out of the UI as designed.

Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers; the raid/mythic/all-bosses aggregate page returns HTTP 403 with __NEXT_DATA__ absent. spec.survivability untouched (40 rows). Independently of the wall the documented dead end still stands and was not re-litigated: the aggregate raid survivability tierList has published EMPTY across all three roles since 2026-08-16, and sourcing it from a per-boss page is a measured dead end (2 of 9 bosses publish it, the only complete 40/40 set is a world boss, 21 of 38 specs disagree between the two populated bosses, and the numeric column sits at 1-2 parses). Correct behaviour is to leave the stored aggregate standing.

Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers; the specRankingsSection JSON lives behind the same challenge as the tierList, so a walled page yields neither letters nor numbers. Recorded as its own row rather than folded into a single Archon row, per the split-row rule, so it stays visible which of the six numeric series failed. Stored '95th pct DPS (Mythic)' rows byte-identical (32 rows), coverage date correctly stays 2026-08-25. Fire Mage remains absent by upstream design (nobody logs it at Mythic), which is data rather than a failure.
Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers. Stored '95th pct HPS (Mythic)' rows byte-identical (7 rows), coverage date stays 2026-08-25. Kept as its own row per the split-row rule.

Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers; the three /heroic/ rankings pages return the identical HTTP 403 with __NEXT_DATA__ absent. Stored '95th pct DPS (Heroic)' rows byte-identical (33 rows), coverage date stays 2026-08-24 - now 4 days old. This is the dense early-season series and, since the 2026-08-25 owner decision, the basis of Archon's raid LETTERS, so its staleness matters more than the Mythic cut's; the red is the honest signal.
Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers. Stored '95th pct HPS (Heroic)' rows byte-identical (7 rows), coverage date stays 2026-08-24. Kept as its own row per the split-row rule.

Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers; the three mythic-plus/10/all-dungeons/this-week pages return HTTP 403. Stored 'M+ score (95th pct)' rows byte-identical (40 rows), coverage date stays 2026-08-25.

Not reachable - same site-wide wall as archon-tiers. Stored 'Popularity' rows byte-identical (79 rows, all six role x bracket groups still summing to 100.0), coverage date stays 2026-08-25. Fire Mage stays pending upstream rather than carrying a stale S1 share.

Upstream frozen for 17 days; both endpoints fetched fine, so this is not our transport. Two plain curls, no headers, no proxy: manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 (completedAt 2026-08-11T22:52:39.026Z) and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json HTTP 200, 161 KB, returning Last-Modified 'Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT' - the two agree. Per the 2026-08-04 pinned-manifest lesson the PAYLOAD was diffed rather than trusted to the manifest: 44 blocks, whitelist categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === 'lowerBound' AND keyRange undefined selects exactly 3 blocks = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, and all 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts are identical to stored at the series' 1-dp stored precision. The melee/ranged blocks were excluded by whitelist rather than by blacklisting 'dungeon', since they are subsets of dps and would double-count 27 specs. Nothing to merge, so asOf correctly stays at the source's own 2026-08-11 snapshotDate and the coverage date does not move. This is the owner-accepted standing red recorded on the contract row - it clears when WoWMeta re-runs; do not ack it away and do not raise maxAgeDays.

Read from the pre-agent evidence file, not from any fetch of ours: wcl-fetch/evidence.json, attemptedAt 2026-08-28T21:14:24.373Z, verdict 'rdps-broken'. Transport is healthy on both legs (oauth true, graphql true, 3600 points/hour with 1 spent), and the single sanctioned retry - characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 - returned HTTP 200 carrying 'Internal server error' with 0 rankings. Both 'landed' and 'rawRecipes' are empty objects, so no key could honestly claim success. This is the owner-accepted standing red on the contract row: no zone-53 fetch path exists while the HTML statistics transport is Cloudflare-blocked and the GraphQL rdps family errors server-side. Stored 'Median ... (Mythic ...)' medians byte-identical (47 rows) at their 2026-08-10 coverage date, now 18 days old. This agent made no warcraftlogs.com request of any kind, by any means.

Same pre-agent evidence file and same verdict as wcl-live-raid: wcl-fetch/evidence.json attemptedAt 2026-08-28T21:14:24.373Z, verdict 'rdps-broken', landed {} and rawRecipes {}. No zone-55 recipe exists while the rdps metric family 500s server-side, so the row is unreachable and the stored 'Median ... (M+, all dungeons ...)' medians stay byte-identical (40 rows) at their 2026-08-10 coverage date. Owner-accepted standing red; it clears when a zone-55 recipe lands, not by acking. No warcraftlogs.com request was made by this agent.

MERGED 40 rows from a genuinely newer cut. Plain browser-UA GET on the three meta pages (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 70.9 / 41.9 / 40.6 KB. All three carry a machine-readable <time datetime="2026-08-28T03:00:2xZ">, against the 2026-08-27T18:36Z cut the previous run merged, so the values moved overnight rather than within a stale page. Parse anchored on the BARE 'meta-item' class token inside the <a> tag rather than on a fixed attribute order, because murlok varies its attribute order and a strict form silently drops href-first rows. 27 / 7 / 6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched, ranks verified contiguous 1..N on each page before merging. All 40 values moved; largest Destruction Warlock +1.19% (3117 -> 3154), then Frost Death Knight +0.87% and Frost Mage +0.85%, median about +0.4% - far under maxValueMovePct 0.6 and consistent with a night of top-50 rating churn. Stored as integers to match the series' own precision; no n (murlok exposes none). All three pages self-identify 'Midnight Season 2 ... Patch 12.1'. asOf = 2026-08-28, the cut's own date.

HELD WHOLESALE for a third night, same reason as 08-27: this is a DELIBERATE HOLD, not a fetch failure. All 27 DPS specs requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with up to 3 retries each: 19 returned real charts and 8 returned the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body (Havoc, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Retribution, Arms, Fury - the documented persistent set, unchanged from last night). Every one of the 19 reads simc_settings.tier = MID2 (ptr is the string "0", as documented) with chart timestamps 2026-08-26, against 26 stored profiles all on MID1 at 2026-07-08/07-15. Merging the 19 is blocked three independent ways, any one sufficient: SIM_TIER_REQUIRED plus the tier-uniformity invariant forbid a pool holding both MID1 and MID2; fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key and derives its ST/cleave/AoE labels as within-role percentiles, so a partial merge would publish WHICH specs upstream has re-simmed as if it were spec strength; and 19 of 26 rows is past maxRowDropPct 0.25. Merged NOTHING; stored fightProfile values, tiers and dates are byte-identical and the coverage date correctly stays 2026-07-08 rather than being re-stamped. FLAG FOR THE OWNER, unchanged: the eventual landing is a wholesale MID2 adoption and will need a human value_move_ack - the value-move gate has no agent-writable proposal channel.

HELD for a third night; coverage is still the blocker and one upstream fact changed. MID2_Raid.txt is 1.20 MB, Last-Modified 2026-08-28T07:40:15Z, and DOES carry a complete 'DPS Ranking:' block of 38 profiles; its header self-identifies '12.1.0.69497 Live (hotfix 2026-08-27/69497, git build HEAD 6266922349)' - a NEW build against last night's 32146c2cc6, and Live rather than PTR. Mapped by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed, those 38 profiles reach only 19 of the 27 DPS roster specs (absent: Devourer DH, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Retribution, Arms, Fury - the same eight bloodmallet is missing, which locates the upstream re-sim queue rather than being coincidence), and the 19 sit +61% to +125% above their stored MID1 values. Adopting 19 of 26 would trip both the row-drop floor and maxValueMovePct, and mixing MID1 and MID2 rows under the season-agnostic name 'SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS', whose ranks are pooled across the family, is the mislabel honest typing forbids. NEW TONIGHT and worth carrying forward: MID1_Raid.txt is now itself a 272-byte in-progress log carrying the SAME 12.1.0.69497 header, i.e. MID1 is being re-run against 12.1, while MID1_Raid.html - the actual source of the stored 26 - remains the 2026-08-08 / 12.0.7.68974 artefact. The MID1 fallback is therefore even less of a stable anchor than the contract row already says. Merged nothing; stored rows byte-identical, coverage date stays 2026-08-08.

MERGED 38 rows. /period/latest HTTP 200, 199 KB, 302-resolving to period 1078, week 2 of MID2 - the same period the previous run read, but MATURED rather than static: the subtitle now reads 10,000 characters (3,384 unique), 16.3 average key level, against (4,397 unique) and 15.4 yesterday, and 30 of the 38 values moved. Parse BOUNDED to the 'Spec representation in top keys' section, ending at the 'Classes and specs' heading; scanning the whole page instead picks up the classes block and the per-dungeon sections and yields the wrong chart under the right series name. Labels normalised across the lowercase-hyphenated form and the value taken from the span AFTER the bar's height: style, so the bar height is not read as the value. Shape checks before deciding: sum 100.1% with role subtotals DPS 60.1 / Tank 20.1 / Healer 19.9, i.e. the representation SHARE column rather than the /meta per-key-presence figure. The largest relative moves (Outlaw 1.5 -> 2.5, Enhancement 1.5 -> 0.9, Devastation 0.3 -> 0.1) are all sub-1-point rows and sit under minValueMagnitude 100 by design. TWO SPECS LEFT THE CHART ENTIRELY: Augmentation Evoker and Frost Mage, both of which the 08-27 page rendered at an explicit 0.0 and neither of which appears in tonight's block at all (Fire Mage still does, at 0.0, so the page does still render zeros). Their stored rows were deliberately LEFT UNTOUCHED at value 0 / asOf 2026-08-27 rather than re-stamped, because writing 0 under today's date would assert a reading the page did not give; the family therefore holds 40 rows of which 2 carry yesterday's date, which is visible and honest, and the coverage date is the 25th-freshest asOf so the gate reads today.

All live lanes polled, 0 new builds; data/ptr-builds.json untouched and its newest entry stays the 2026-08-27 live hotfix round-up, which this morning's local run had already landed. (a) Wowhead news RSS HTTP 200, 148 KB, 40 items parsed per <item> block, window 2026-08-25 to 2026-08-28 15:16 CDT; the only class-tuning item in it is news=382657 'Vashnik LFR Nerf - Patch 12.1 Hotfixes for August 27th', whose content:encoded body was re-read tonight and matches the stored entry line for line, including all six class lines and the three class-wide attributions (Blur, Flameshaper, Deathstalker). (b) The news INDEX polled as well, because it LEADS the RSS within a run: data.news.newsData brace-balanced from its id attribute, 20 posts, top id 382668 at 15:16, nothing the RSS lacked. (c) Blue-tracker index data.blueTracker.default, 50 entries; newest class-relevant topic is still Kaivax's 27 August hotfix (2336376, 19:59), already this feed's citation, with only Black Temple / WoW Weekly / BCC items and a 'Raid Bonus Roll Update' above it. (d) The canonical running hotfix post was read DIRECTLY rather than inferred from its tracker timestamp, since it is edited in place: 2336376.json post 1 updated_at 2026-08-28T00:59:15Z, dated sections running August 27, 26, 25, 21, 20, 19, 18, 17, 14, 13 - there is NO August 28 section and the literal string 'August 28' does not appear. (e) The 12.1 development-notes thread 2317811 is at post #19, last posted 2026-07-31T23:42Z: unchanged, the closed cycle's expected silence rather than a lost thread. No 12.2 PTR announcement in any lane, so PHASES.ptr stays null and the dormant WCL PTR zone sweeps (54/52/56/57) were correctly skipped. No set-bonus text was touched anywhere, so no spec.tierSet needed advancing and the gearing mirror needed no resync. Watch item: topic 2335871 'Season 2 Class Tuning Plans' is now 190 posts but Kaivax appears only at post #1 (unedited since 2026-08-12); its roadmap still promises a pass after the first full week of live S2 data, and izen independently says in tonight's distilled video that another balance round lands at the end of this week.

All 44 transcribable channels polled via the YouTube RSS endpoint, 0 failures, 15 entries each = 660 videos; the asOf pair is the newest distilled take/metaNote date before and after this run, which does not advance because tonight's newest read is izen's 2026-08-27 video and last night's was also dated 08-27. All FIVE queued videos had transcripts pre-fetched by the deterministic step (transcript-fetch/summary.json attemptedAt 2026-08-28T21:14:27Z, verdict 'ok', 5 requested / 5 fetched): 3 takes and 7 metaNotes added, 8 prior entries superseded, 2 verified skips. izen's x429ozbMXnQ (Season 2 M+ meta, 26 min) gives seven M+ metaNotes - Arcane Mage, Arms Warrior, Elemental Shaman, Holy Paladin and Blood Death Knight positive, Restoration Shaman and Assassination Rogue mixed; Assassination is logged mixed rather than positive because izen calls it 'the first asterisk of the season', a very high average score he cannot explain beyond four consecutive flat percentage buffs, with a profile much weaker on forced single target. Six prior izen M+ notes superseded (five from 08-25, Resto Shaman's from 08-21). AutomaticJak's l1qKWWYZGZE gives two RAID takes, Holy Priest buff and Discipline Priest nerf, both superseding his 08-21 raid takes. Musguete's ps4If_WbBPQ gives one RAID Outlaw buff take - normally the guide-shaped no-take case, but it carries an explicit placement claim with a mechanism (the new raid's two- and three-target cleave bosses) read off his own meters. THE ONE THING DELIBERATELY NOT LOGGED, flagged for the owner rather than decided: AutomaticJak's substantive M+ Holy Priest passage, in which he names a tier outright, was not distilled because he is the bylined author of the Wowhead M+ healer tier list - one of our four consensus sources - and logging it would feed consensusFor and expertRead from one voice on the same cell (the Tactyks firewall shape). His pre-existing 08-21 M+ takes were left live: flag, never retire. Also declined: izen's Outlaw mention (a scoring artifact about swapping specs mid-week, not a strength read) and his bare Marksmanship / Shadow Priest / Holy enumeration (the list-mention rule). Verified skips moved to skipped[] with reasons: AutomaticJak's rGk2fajsQ1g (59-second how-to, no comparative read) and Critcake's if8kxRXBzSA (31-minute pug key run whose three strength-adjacent lines are enjoyment, one fight, and chat answers about specs outside his declared Arms/Fury scope). Queue maintenance: the 5 processed ids removed from videos[], 1 new video appended - Obli's n0H4JFE6Suc, queued on its DESCRIPTION rather than its title ('Frost got buffed with this reset but has it actually done anything for us in the raid? Short answer, no'), a raid-scoped read inside his declared Frost/Unholy scope. Seen-set union 1,212; 220 unseen in-cycle videos of which 130 pass the keyword filter, and the 129 not queued stay UNSEEN rather than being written to seen[] - a budget cut is exactly the dismissal class that must remain reconsiderable. Nightly keyword filtering kept, per the 100-request monthly Supadata budget. No YouTube or transcript-API request was made by this agent.
